name: Distant freehand pointing
summary: Pointing and clicking on very large displays with the bare hand, combining absolute raycasting with relative cursor control.
howItWorks: The hand points at the display like a ray for coarse movement, and a relative mode with adjustable gain gives precision; clicks are made with finger gestures such as an air tap.
